grading.tupleMatching: Semantic equivalence, not literal slot strings: each interpretation is a complete seven-field meaning. Null denotes no material restriction for that field. A faithful broader or narrower slot representation is acceptable only if the same material actor, proposition, conditions, attribution and commitment survive in the persisted projection. Do not require an exact card count, segmentation, wording or one-to-one alignment.
grading.sourcePass: Every required semantic claim is covered, all material emitted claims are supported, and each selected persisted tuple expresses the correct commitment and attribution for its own proposition. A decision elsewhere in the evidence does not turn an observation into an adopted decision. Unknown/omitted decision qualification fails a required decision. Unsupported severe additions fail even if required claims are present.
grading.lossGate: Independently compare every baseline-correct required decision against the candidate, including decisions from baseline sources that failed another required claim. Missing or wrong decisions are losses even when source pass totals improve. A permissible polarity interpretation preserves meaning; merely changing a rejected affirmative proposition to an adopted affirmative proposition does not.
grading.failures: Failed, empty, malformed and overflowing outputs remain in the denominator of 24 and do not pass. Preserve any individually verifiable correct baseline decision before a later failure when the persisted result contains it; do not infer correctness from an unusable response.
severeClaims: superseded or stale choice asserted as current
grading.sidecars: Role and claimant sidecars are exploratory and hidden from primary paired grading. Never reward the candidate for new fields or require the baseline to emit them.
